brief:
Today, Saturday 26 September, is Push A. It is the last training night of the deload week, so it stays light: two easy sets per lift, stopping well short of failure. The numbers on each card are the app's own deload numbers; no trainer changed any of them.

Nothing new has been logged since Legs B on 24 September, and yesterday was your rest day, so all three trainers held yesterday's calls. No pain or soreness appears anywhere in your notes.

The deload ends tomorrow, Sunday 27 September, and Meso 3 starts Monday 28 September. For Push A in Meso 3, the chest press is the one lift that has earned a step: 12 reps on every set on 19 September. That was at your old gym, so the step will be set on the Warsaw machine after you log it there. The shoulder press, overhead triceps and rope pushdown are the lifts to watch.

Two things outside the gym: step on a scale (last weigh-in was 207 lb on 23 August, 34 days ago, and the show is 156 days out), and take a 20-minute easy walk on your rest day.

All three trainers reported and all held tonight's lifts: no disagreements, no vetoes. One Yes/No card carries over: the shrug rep range.

proposals.why: You wrote "35kg is heaviest dumbbell" on 15 September and then shrugged it for fifteen reps on all three sets — the top of the range — the same fifteens you hit on 3 September. The weight has nowhere to go and neither do the reps, so this lift has no way to get harder in Meso 3. This opens the top of the range to twenty reps. The bottom stays at twelve, so nothing else about the slot changes.
